newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche Bank says will not meet Horlick.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank says will not meet Horlick.

text.p: The management board of Deutsche Bank will not meet fund manager Nicola Horlick to discuss her resignation, a spokesman for the banks's investment banking unit Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Friday.

Earlier, Horlick told BBC Television that she was flying to Frankfurt to put her case to senior Deutsche executives, but the DMG spokesman said: "We are not aware of any meeting being requested and such a request will not be granted, she is no longer an employee."
